   WARFARE SYSTEMS POSES A HIGH RISK FOR CIVIL FLIGHTS OPERATING 
   AT ALL ALTITUDES AND FLIGHT LEVELS.

   ARE ADVISED NOT TO ENTER FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV),
   FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), 
   FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR ROSTOV (URRV) AND TO TAKE ALL POTENTIAL 
   RISK INTO ACCOUNT IN RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING 
   DECISIONS WHEN OPERATING 200NM SURROUNDING THE BORDERS WITH
   UKRAINE IN THE FIR MOSCOW (UUWW) AND FIR ROSTOV (URRV).
